bundle.notes: Rebuilt from the upstream semantic ABI digest fix (6741682): class fingerprints now describe class shape instead of hashing old DEX bytes, so they load with the newer dexlib2 used by Morphe Patcher 2.x. Verified on the official 9.1.80.2221 APK: 8/8 patches applied and the APK was rebuilt in a JVM harness on 2026-11-13; no on-device installation test was possible here.
